# Rust SDK / JavaScript 1.6.6 testnet verification

Date: 2026-08-19 UTC

Implementation commits: `7231c50` and `e288f2f` (on top of the 1.6.6 parity
commits listed in git history).

Every row below was accepted by the TBC testnet node and fetched back from the
public API byte-for-byte. Fees use the exact signed size at 80 sat/KB with an
80 sat minimum unless a released contract intentionally retains a larger fee.
Pool and MultiSig contract inputs also passed the pinned `tbc-lib-js`
interpreter before submission.

## TBC20

| Stage | Txid | Bytes | Paid | Target | Result |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Source | `b8e5efd04183ac0fdb954fd7c82191bb3d85e51ff7ab9a369cbd5807ecabb3f5` | 192 | 80 | 80 | accepted/refetched |
| Mint | `bde522c059946532b1c265bbe6407e2aed923b983d42c80b046a11a3edac09df` | 2702 | 217 | 217 | accepted/refetched |
| Transfer 400 + change 600 | `34e77b67251f4eaadd8e395dcffd9ccd148945f9ce0f9449b6ae2c63b3ca8105` | 6364 | 510 | 510 | accepted/refetched |
| Merge 400 + 600 | `571fe6f15da7776aa0d334ee65c2e0f0ba979acb60cde54778933130cb9f1767` | 5209 | 417 | 417 | accepted/refetched |

The merge was then passed to the public async validator with only its root
transaction and `network="testnet"`. The SDK fetched its parent and ancestor
itself and returned `VALID`, protocol `TBC20:v1`, no issues, input/output raw
amount `1000`, and all four mandatory assurances:

- `STRUCTURE`
- `TRANSITION`
- `OUTPUT_SOURCE_LINEAGE`
- `OUTPUT_SOURCE_GRAPH_RESOLVED`

This report contains no private key or unbroadcast raw transaction.

set remain unchanged; FT-A/TBC reserves follow the released integer formulas;
FTLP issuance/burn follows reserve deltas; locked init and increase deduct the
24 sat LP cost and place its payment at output 6; lock-time FTLP becomes
publicly spendable only after expiry.

## OrderBook with StableCoin v4

The first live match exposed a missing 2076-byte v4 Code/Tape pairing and was
rejected by consensus. Commit `e288f2f` fixes that serialization and pins its
current-output digest to the exact JavaScript 1.6.6 oracle. The successful
rerun is:

| Stage | Txid | Bytes | Paid |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Coin NFT | `f32366ffa31b44716e498a58b6290df9dd8745cd4ee91e349a58c60a458de4ff` | 740 | 80 |
| Coin mint | `c170c35655e00246efb55b7079477c418fdad3f69c7aa52aa0a9ba32548149cc` | 4078 | 327 |
| Funding split | `5016fff0a0be9b9c3ab0473588f71b8cc0df7ff71923d59662e4bd7aaf877dfe` | 259 | 80 |
| Buy order | `76d1e1d643eb60dc34bf23369d26caeab2ebed62ac4fa055e23268de59a0185d` | 7060 | 565 |
| Sell order | `a48efd33277f44fbc58051548b85c01c8c8f47256114279737a30e0e503af089` | 1148 | 92 |
| Match | `dd0829d60ca81db8d70950a6f518525938d3f6463d04911df9ca3f13c1d46a37` | 8625 | 1801 |

The match consumes both order identities and the v4 FT pair atomically, pays
the buyer/seller and both fee destinations, and conserves the matched TBC and
raw StableCoin amounts. Its retained 1801 sat fee matches released OrderBook
behavior (690 sat size floor plus the contract's fixed reserve).
